value.rationale: Exact conditional mean of a physically central magic functional for all Born probability vectors replaces Monte Carlo phase averaging; the flat-Born specialization rigorously establishes extensive expected magic and a logarithmic high-probability lower window despite a zero-magic state with the identical Born law. This is a complete natural ensemble invariant with clear contrast to the 2026 deterministic minimizer, not a hand-picked small example. Only the one-sided concentration and phase-independent model are asserted.
